I have grown cassava on this piece since I was a young girl. I will not use chemical fertilizer or pesticide — that cash is for salt and soap — but I will spread goat manure from my compound before planting. I will use my own cuttings and wait for the November rains; I have no way to water the field. My daughter and I will work this plot for thirty days, and I will hire two young men for two days to clear the thick bushes.
